purpose: Teach: 久美子/節子/涼子/亜紀/いずみ/千里/かおり/片側

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「久美子おばさんは料理上手」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — Dad was saying Aunt Kumiko is really good at cooking.
lines.style: Warm, conversational tone. Sharing something small and genuine that Dad mentioned. Gentle pacing, like she's offering him a small piece of his father's words.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと節子おばさんに会いに行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I went to see Dad and Aunt Setsuko.
lines.style: Bright, present-moment enthusiasm. Quick, eager delivery. Pride in having done something with Dad. Small-voiced but completely genuine, no performance.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「涼子いとこが結婚されたわ」って語って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho — Dad mentioned that Cousin Ryoko got married.
lines.style: Reflective, gentle. Passing along family news with the tenderness of someone who knows he needs to hear about these connections. Slight pause on the name, like it matters.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと亜紀ちゃんの誕生日会に行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I got to go to Aki's birthday party with Dad.
lines.style: Simple joy. Not loud, but warm. The satisfaction of a small outing shared with someone he loves. Natural, unforced.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「いずみちゃんとピアノ連弾しよう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — Dad was saying Izumi would like to play a piano duet with you.
lines.style: Reflective, almost delicate. Offering this gently, as if it's a small gift of information. Quiet warmth. Waiting for his reaction.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと千里おばさんの家でお茶飲んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I drank tea at Aunt Chisato's house with Dad.
lines.style: Straightforward recounting with small-boy pride. Simple, direct. The kind of memory a six-year-old treasures — sitting quietly with an adult he trusts.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「かおりちゃんはピアノが上手」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — Dad was saying Kaori is really good at piano.
lines.style: Reflective, conversational. Passing along an observation as if Dad's words are something worth holding. Warm, almost admiring of the fact itself.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「自転車は道の片側を守って走る」って教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Dad taught me that bikes should stay on one side of the road.
lines.style: Earnest, attentive. Processing something important Dad has taught him — not just facts, but care for how to be safe. Quiet conviction. A lesson taken seriously.
